from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single data point extracted from a statistical release for a specific month and region."""
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Date the statistical release was published (YYYY-MM-DD), used to resolve precedence conflicts")
    data_month: str = Field(description="The YYYY-MM period the housing start data belongs to")
    region: str = Field(description="The Census region (e.g., Northeast, Midwest, South, West)")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Number of housing starts (not seasonally adjusted), in thousands")
    is_preliminary: bool = Field(description="True if the specific value is marked preliminary ('p') in the report")
    is_revised: bool = Field(description="True if the specific value is marked revised ('r') in the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for all housing start records extracted from the document collection."""
    housing_start_records: list[HousingStartRecord]
